title: Enable Banking: sign up and check your three banks are covered, before anything is built

intro.verdict_html: The plan was to read Halifax, Revolut and AMEX through Enable Banking's free tier. Its public list of UK banks does not show any of the three. The list behind a sign-in may differ, and only you can sign up. This is ten minutes to find out; nothing gets built on it until the answer is known. If they are not covered, the fallback is the email and file import, which needs no bank link at all.
prerequisites: An email address for the account
cost: Free. Do not enter card details anywhere; if it asks, stop and say so in the box below.

steps.title: Create the account
steps.body_html: Sign up. Choose the free or restricted (personal use) option if asked.

steps.title: Look for the three banks

where.label: Enable Banking → Control Panel → ASPSPs / Banks

steps.body_html: Find the list of banks (it may be called ASPSPs), filter to United Kingdom, and look for Halifax (or Lloyds Banking Group), Revolut and American Express.

steps.title: Anything it asked for
steps.body_html: Note anything unexpected: a card, a company number, a production approval step, a limit on how many accounts.

notes.html: Do not link a bank yet and do not create an application. That comes with the build, in its own checklist, once coverage is known.
